title: Yakalla City Map
description: A detailed fantasy cartographic illustration of the circular coastal city of Yakalla, divided into distinct colored districts radiating from a central plaza. The city is surrounded by a river on the left and a busy harbor with multiple sailing ships on the right, with decorative compass roses and ornate border elements.
prompt: highly detailed fantasy map of a perfectly circular coastal city named Yakalla, with clearly segmented colorful districts arranged in concentric rings around a central plaza, a winding river on the left side, a bustling harbor with multiple wooden sailing ships docked on the right, ornate decorative borders and compass roses, in the style of an antique illuminated manuscript map, rich colors, intricate architectural details visible from top-down perspective
